rows.en: (All right! Now I just have to shoot this one down!!)

(Phew~ I'm beat...
Still, I was in such good form in today's
simulator training that it surprised even me.)

(I'd better keep working hard so I can
get good results next time too...)
Yes? What is it, Gary-sensei?

Your moves in today's simulator training
weren't half bad.

So here's the thing...
How'd you like to enlist in the New U.N. Forces?

With your skills as they are now, you should be
able to fight to protect Frontier.

Back at the career survey, you said you wanted
to be a soldier, right? What do you say?
Well, I...
I want to enlist in the New U.N. Forces
I want to join S.M.S.

Got it.
Then I'll write you a letter of recommendation
to the New U.N. Forces.

It's you guys who'll be protecting Frontier's
future. Give it everything you've got.

(I don't know how far my abilities will take me...
but I'm gonna do my best for Frontier!)

I see...
Then I can't very well force a recommendation
on you.
I'm sorry.

Nah, don't worry about it.
Just keep up the good work from here on!

(I turned down the recommendation to the New
U.N. Forces, but it makes me really happy that
Gary-sensei thinks so highly of me...)

Hey, \p!
What are you dawdling for?
Let's hurry up and go grab something to eat.
Oh, sorry, Michel.

By the way, I was watching you during simulator
training. You're pretty good, you know that?

(Not just Gary-sensei,
but even Michel is praising me...)
With skills like that, you could make it in S.M.S...
rows.notes: Michel trails off before saying more about S.M.S.; kept unfinished as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Hm? What's wrong, Michel?
Nothing at all. Come on, let's go.
Yeah, let's...

(Michel was about to say something...
I wonder what it was?)

(Well, no point worrying about it.
Right, I'd better hurry and go get changed...)
(It's rare for Michel to praise me...)

(Phew~ I'm beat...
Still, I was in such good form in today's
simulator training that it surprised even me.)
Well, I...

(I don't know how far my abilities will take me...
but I'm gonna do my best for Frontier!)
Oh, sorry, Michel-kun.

(Not just Gary-sensei,
but even Michel-kun is praising me...)
Hm? What's wrong, Michel-kun?

(Michel-kun was about to say something...
I wonder what it was?)
(It's rare for Michel-kun to praise me...)

(All right, today's Sports Day!
I'm gonna do my best to shine too!!)
What is it, Gary-sensei?

Thing is, there was a little mix-up, and we're
short on entrants for three events.

Sorry, but I need you to enter one of
the three events I'm about to name.
Actually, you don't get a say in this.
rows.notes: Kyohiken wa nai: "you have no right to refuse".

rows.en: Y-yes, understood...

The first event is the "100m Dash."
If you're confident in your "Stamina" and
"Speed," give this one a shot.
rows.notes: Stat names (tairyoku/sokudo) rendered as pilot parameters "Stamina"/"Speed"; shared with scd_fes_510, both genders.

rows.en:
The second event is the "Tug-of-War."
If you're confident in your "Melee" and
"Defense," give this one a shot.

The third event is the "Ball Toss."
If you're confident in your "Shooting" and
"Focus," give this one a shot.

Out of these three events,
which one do you want to enter?
100m Dash
Tug-of-War
Ball Toss

Got it, the 100m dash.
I'll take care of the entry,
so go warm up or something.
(I'm gonna do my best to take first place!)

Who'd have thought I'd be running in the same
heat as you. Just so you know, I'm not going easy.

Yo, Fresh Boy.
I'm going all out too, so brace yourself.
rows.notes: Luis calls the male player "fresh boy" (katakana English): kept as "Fresh Boy". Male only.

rows.en:
Wait, why are you just casually
taking part, Luis-san?

Don't sweat the details.
Now, the show's about to start!

I'm cheering for you like crazy too~!
Go at it like your life depends on it~!!

(I can't lose to Alto or Luis-san.
I'm definitely winning this!)
(Yes~! First place!!)

Tch!
I can't believe I lost to \p...
Next time, I'm definitely winning!

So you made it over the wall that is me...
Not bad, Fresh Boy.

Heh, something about you reminds me
of myself when I was young...
Nice one~, \p.

Heh heh heh...
But don't gloat until you've beaten me...
rows.notes: Hoshimura (Yui) boasting, then backing down in c22411 (presumably under a glare).

rows.en: Uh, n-no, just kidding...

(I actually beat Alto and Luis-san.
I'm so happy.)

(I'd better keep up my training so I can
win at next year's Sports Day too.)
rows.notes: x10 across win and loss branches of both scenes; the Japanese has "demo" (next year too).

rows.en: (Dammit! I was so close to winning...)

I can't afford to lose to you,
so I went all out.

Looks like you're still nowhere near my level.
Go retrain your passion,
then come challenge me!

Whaaat, you lost~?
And I bet on \p to win...
rows.notes: Yui lets slip she bet on the player; shared male/female.

rows.en: Uh... never mind.

(I really thought I'd take first place...
I'll train hard so I definitely
don't lose at the next Sports Day!)

Got it, the tug-of-war.
I'll take care of the entry,
so go warm up or something.
(All right! I'd better do my best too!)

Oh, \p-san,
you're in the tug-of-war too?
Let's join forces and win this for sure!

If we all pull together, we're sure to win!
Let's believe in our strength and seize victory!

G-good luck!
And please be careful not to get hurt.
(All right! I'm definitely winning this!)

uncertain: c22389-c22391: Gary names stats in brackets (tairyoku, sokudo, kakutou, bougyo, shageki, shuuchuu). Not campus Mind/Technique/Body; read as pilot parameters and rendered 'Stamina', 'Speed', 'Melee', 'Defense', 'Shooting', 'Focus'. Should match the in-game parameter labels if they differ.
c22399/c22407: Luis's nickname for the male player, furesshu booi, kept as 'Fresh Boy' (no glossary entry; the female form furesshu gaaru appears 62 times elsewhere, suggest 'Fresh Girl').
c22368: Michel's cut-off line about S.M.S. kept unfinished.
missing_glossary: Fresh Boy / Fresh Girl (Luis's nickname for the player)
